visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Indoor setting; three young women are seated on the floor or a low bed in a domestic living room, surrounded by takeout containers. A man in a white t-shirt descends stairs behind them. The lighting is bright and indoor-focused. They interact casually, gesturing while discussing food. (2) Outdoor scene; a woman with short dark hair, wearing a white cardigan over a black top, walks down a narrow urban alleyway with parked scooters. She stops at a small food stall where a female vendor in a brown apron hands her a wrapped food item. They exchange friendly words and smiles. (3) Indoor setting again; the group is gathered together. The man is now holding and eating the wrapped roll. His facial expression transitions from skepticism to pleasant surprise. The women watch him intently, laughing and talking as he enjoys the meal.
